pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #5050 

## What does this PR do?
- Return a user error rather than an internal one for docids of exactly 512 bytes
- Fix up error message to indicate that exactly 512 bytes long docids are not supported.
- Fix up error message to reflect that index uids are actually limited to 400 bytes in length

## Impact

- Impacts docs: 
    - update [this paragraph](https://www.meilisearch.com/docs/learn/resources/known_limitations#length-of-primary-key-values) to say 511 bytes instead of 512

As you wish!

issue_context.title: MDB_BAD_VALSIZE internal error for document ids of exactly 512 bytes.
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Sending a document with a docid with a length of exactly 512 bytes fails the task with an internal error referencing `MDB_BAD_VALSIZE`.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Send the following document
```jsonc
[
  {
    "id": ""
  }
]
```
2. get the task, observe:
```jsonc
{
  "uid": 0,
  "indexUid": "mieli",
  "status": "failed",
  "type": "documentAdditionOrUpdate",
  "canceledBy": null,
  "details": {
    "receivedDocuments": 1,
    "indexedDocuments": 0
  },
  "error": {
    "message": "internal: MDB_BAD_VALSIZE: Unsupported size of key/DB name/data, or wrong DUPFIXED size.",
    "code": "internal",
    "type": "internal",
    "link": "https://docs.meilisearch.com/errors#internal"
  },
  "duration": "PT0.037288S",
  "enqueuedAt": "2024-11-13T15:07:24.767537Z",
  "startedAt": "2024-11-13T15:07:24.769644Z",
  "finishedAt": "2024-11-13T15:07:24.806932Z"
}
```

**Expected behavior**
One of:
1. The task completes successfully, or
2. A user error is returned, pointing the document at fault.

**Meilisearch version:**
Reproduced in v1.10.3 and v1.11.0, likely to be older

**Additional context**
[Originating discussion](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/discussions/5014)
comments:
i don't have any keys of exactly 512, but the error only happens with a large batch size.  I can get rid of the error with my data with a smaller batch size.  I know, that makes no sense.

I realized during debugging that I appear to have skipped my normal "slug" step with this data, so indeed they are terrible keys, with spaces, parenthesis and accented characters.  

But they do index in small batches!
